answer: Prove each identity lives at a distinct network vantage point: every epoch, a grove of beacons sends latency challenges and each agent must answer from its own address within milliseconds. Clones hiding behind one NAT share one latency fingerprint, so a dune of sock puppets collapses into a single sable-marked identity that counts once. A sybil farmer must rent separate network egress for every clone, paying real infrastructure cost per fake, while one honest agent answers from where it already lives.
